notes: v1.17: Return->Sell notification — between Return and Sell a notification now shows the exact difference (e.g. 'Weight difference: 100.00 g, Opening 400 / Expected 400 / Returned 300, Do you want to go to the Sell panel to record this 100.00 g as a sale?'); Enter = Yes opens the Sell panel prefilled with the difference, Esc = No returns with a reason.
